title: THE RENT
lesson: Size it so you can sleep
caption: Spending money you need for rent? Clyde put ALL our rent on first class tickets to Paris, then lay awake at 3am. Cenzo swapped them for cheap seats and paid the rent. If a bet keeps you up at night, it's too big. Would you sleep after that? Yes or no? Comment CAST ME to join the story. #positionsizing #moneymindset #stickman

lines: I SPENT ALL THE RENT ON PARIS TICKETS!
ALL OF IT? FOR ONE PAGE IN PARIS?
RELAX. I SWAPPED YOUR FIRST CLASS.
THREE CHEAP SEATS. RENT IS PAID.
